title: braws: a little world, your real friends
description: braws is a small, invite-only app for close friends: a pet, a room, a stamp a day, a shared world map, a wall and plans. For iPhone and iPad, 16+.
ogDescription: A pet, a room and a few minutes a day with the friends who matter. Invite-only, for iPhone and iPad.
twitterDescription: A pet, a room and a few minutes a day with the friends who matter.
ogImageAlt: braws: a little world, your real friends. An illustrated room with an orange cat.
heroText: A pet, a room and a few minutes a day with the people who matter. No feed, no strangers, no follower counts.
storeLabel: Get braws, free on the App Store
roomAlt: An illustrated cosy room with a desk, plants, a bookshelf and a round orange cat in the middle.
whatLead: braws is a small, cosy place for you and your closest friends. In the app, your friends are your braws.

cards.title: a pet that needs you
cards.text: Pick a little companion and look after it. It reacts to how you're doing and to how much you show up for your friends.

cards.title: a room all yours
cards.text: Decorate an isometric room with furniture, walls and floors. Your braws can drop by and see it.

cards.title: one stamp a day
cards.text: A photo, a doodle, a mood or a voice note. Over time it becomes a calendar of your days.

cards.title: a shared world
cards.text: See your braws on a little planet. Showing your city is optional and only ever approximate.

cards.title: the weekly wall
cards.text: Share what's going on this week, reply to your braws, and set up a film night, a hike or a coffee.

cards.title: little gifts
cards.text: Send a matcha, a chocolate or a note to someone who needs it today.

petAlt: Mochi, a round orange tabby cat, the pet in the app.
worldAlt: A small globe with your friends' pets pinned on it: a dog, a bunny, an axolotl, a bear, a penguin and you, an orange cat.
howLead: braws is invite-only. You can't search for strangers and they can't find you.

steps.title: get an invite
steps.text: A friend who already uses braws sends you an invite link or a code.

steps.title: get the app
steps.text: Install braws from the App Store, then open the invite link (or type the code).

steps.title: sign in with Apple
steps.text: Pick a username, choose your pet and start your little world together.

safetyLead: Small on purpose. Read the full [[privacy policy]].

checks.text: braws is not for anyone younger.
No email, no password, no phone number.
What's only yours lives on your phone and in your own iCloud, which we can't read.
What you share is seen by the friends you accepted. No public profiles.
Anyone, anytime. Reports are reviewed, normally within 24 hours.
No analytics, no push notifications, and we never sell your data.

faq.q: How do I get an invite?
faq.a: Ask a friend who already uses braws. In the app they can create an invite and send you the link. There's no waitlist and no public sign-up.
Yes. braws has no paid features, no in-app purchases and no ads. The coins and items in the app are just for fun and have no money value.

faq.q: Which devices does it work on?
faq.a: iPhone and iPad. braws isn't on Android yet.

faq.q: Who can see what I post?
faq.a: Only the friends you accepted. Friends of your friends can see your profile and room, so they can send you a request, but not your posts, stamps or location.

faq.q: What happens if I get a new phone?
faq.a: Sign in to the same Apple account with iCloud on and open braws: your pet, room and things come back from your iCloud, and what you shared comes back from our server.

faq.q: Why do I have to be 16?
faq.a: braws is built for close friends who are 16 or older. The app checks your birth month and year on your phone only; that date is never sent to us.
27, including English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and Arabic.

faq.q: How do I delete my account?
faq.a: In the app: settings, then delete account. It's erased from our server straight away. No app? See [[delete your account]].

footTagline: braws · made with care for small circles of friends.
